title: 第14章 拍卖会第15章 炼气境
slug: 混沌神体之鸿蒙至尊未命名95
content_zh:
“落霞山脉有一处结界快破了，应该是一处遗迹”叶辰正色回答
“真的”
“真的，而且你要告诉你父亲组织好人员，一个是怕妖兽袭城，二是怕四大宗门，皇城之人涌入落霞山脉附近的三个郡城”
“好的，我回去就告诉父亲及早做好应对之策”
钱多多走后，叶辰近日无事，开始闭关修炼，每日修炼逍遥剑法，凝练神识，追风步
修炼了五天，追风步终于大成，逍遥剑法剑气入门，识海丈了
叶辰，顶戴金冠，黑色长衫，金丝花纹镶边，玉带紧扣，身背紫霄剑，云纹长靴，剑眉星目，俊逸非凡！
“月儿，你在家看好小墨，我去玲珑商会”
“好的，少爷”
今日来到了玲珑商会，原本琳琅满目的物品，变成了一排排的座椅，大概可以容纳八百多人，二楼是贵宾室20个包间
叶辰进入商会后，取出银色贵宾卡，小厮带着叶辰来到了乙字号包间
侍女备好了点心，泡了壶清神茶
“公子，拍卖会马上开始了，你有什么需要，就请吩咐，拍卖会期间由我来为你服务”侍女一身青绿色长裙，个子较高，挽着乌黑头发，淡淡的清香，清秀可爱！
叶辰看了一会侍女，收回了目光，悠哉悠哉的品起了茶
一楼高台上，玉鸳鸯喜笑颜开，“欢迎各位贵客莅临玲珑商会，本场拍卖会由本姑娘主持，还望各位鼎力支持，拍卖会期间禁止一切挑衅滋事！再次感谢大家的到来！下面有请我们第一件拍品”
顿时原本嘈杂的会场安静了下来，侍女手托托盘走上了高台，站立在高台之上。
“这是一张二阶的闪遁符，瞬息百里，起拍价，1000金币！”玉鸳鸯微笑着面对大家
片刻后，杂乱的声音响了起来，这次拍卖的东西瞬间吸引了大家的热情，闪遁符算得上保命时最有效的方法，关键时刻能救命啊！
“1100金币，我出”
“我出1200金币”

“我出1500金币”
大多数炼气境修士疯狂的加价
“2000金币”，一道哄亮的声音自二楼包间响起
“2200金币”，一楼大厅一位大胡子大叔喊道
“2500金币，我能乃柳家柳云飞”二楼包间传出来声音
也不知是一楼的大叔是背威胁到了还是财力不足，没有继续加价，第一个拍品被柳云飞得到了
拍卖会上一件件的物品在众人的你争我夺中陆陆续续拍了出去
“下面一件拍卖品，是一件黄级炼丹炉，苍云鼎，起拍价3000金币”玉鸳鸯悦耳的声音报着
一楼大厅没有了声音，停顿了一会
这时柳云飞报出“3500金币，要是没有人要的话，这鼎就是本公子的了”
“5000金币”叶辰不及不缓的报出了价格
“5100”柳云飞急喊道
“6000”叶辰是势在必得
“6100”柳云飞有些怒气，
“7000”叶辰也不甘示弱
“7100金币，小子我是柳家的，我哥哥柳云龙可是问天宗内门弟子”
“8000，柳家了不起吗？”因为柳嫣然的关系，叶辰并不响太过为难
“哼，8500金币”柳云飞怒喊道
“金币”叶辰不咸不淡的回着
柳云飞不在加价，黄级炼丹炉基本上不会超过一万金币，实在不行下次再买，吩咐手下“刘魁一会结束了给我盯住这小子”

侍女将苍云鼎送到了包间，叶辰交易了一万金币，现在还剩9万多金币。
玉鸳鸯悦耳的声音再次响起“下面拍卖的是一把玄级鼎峰的雷鸣剑，起拍价2万金币”
“3万金币”一楼一位花白老者高喊着，精神抖擞，筑基九重天的修士，估计是外地的，玄级鼎峰的宝剑，在千风国极其稀少，当然宗门了还是比较乐观的。
“金币”柳云飞
“4万”
content_en:
"There is a barrier in the Luoxia Mountains that is about to be broken. It should be a ruin." Ye Chen replied seriously.
"Really"
"Really, and you have to tell your father to organize the people. One is to be afraid of monsters attacking the city, and the other is to be afraid of the four major sects and the people from the imperial city pouring into the three counties and cities near the Luoxia Mountains."
"Okay, I will tell my father when I get back to prepare countermeasures as soon as possible."
After Qian Duoduo left, Ye Chen had nothing to do recently and began to practice in seclusion. He practiced Xiaoyao Sword Technique every day, condensed his spiritual consciousness, and pursued the wind step.
After practicing for five days, I finally mastered the Chasing Wind Step. I got started with the Xiaoyao Sword Technique and Sword Qi, and my knowledge reached 10 feet.
Ye Chen, wearing a gold crown, a black gown, gold pattern edging, a tightly buckled jade belt, a Zixiao sword on his back, cloud-patterned boots, sword-shaped eyebrows and starry eyes, looks extraordinary and handsome!
"Yue'er, you keep an eye on Xiao Mo at home, I'll go to Linglong Chamber of Commerce."
"Okay, Master"
Today I arrived at the Linglong Chamber of Commerce. What was originally a dazzling array of items has turned into rows of seats, which can accommodate about 800 people. The second floor is a VIP room with 20 private rooms.
After Ye Chen entered the chamber of commerce, he took out his silver VIP card, and the waiter took Ye Chen to the private room number B.
The maid prepared snacks and brewed a pot of refreshing tea.
"Sir, the auction is about to start. If you need anything, please tell me. I will serve you during the auction." The maid is wearing a green dress, tall, with black hair, and a light fragrance. She is pretty and cute!
Ye Chen looked at the maid for a while, then withdrew his gaze, and sipped the tea leisurely.
On the high platform on the first floor, Yu Yuanyang beamed with joy, "Welcome all distinguished guests to the Linglong Chamber of Commerce. This auction will be hosted by this girl. I hope you will support me. All provocations and troubles are prohibited during the auction! Thank you again for coming! Here is our first lot."
Suddenly, the noisy venue became quiet. The maid walked up to the high platform with a tray in hand and stood on the high platform.
"This is a second-level flash escape talisman. It can travel hundreds of miles in an instant. The starting price is 1,000 gold coins!" Yu Yuanyang faced everyone with a smile.
After a while, chaotic sounds rang out. The items in this auction instantly attracted everyone's enthusiasm. The escape talisman is the most effective way to save lives. It can save lives at critical moments!
"1100 gold coins, I'll pay"
"I'll pay you 1,200 gold coins."
"I'll pay you 1,500 gold coins."
Most of the Qi Refining Realm monks are crazy about raising prices
"2000 gold coins," a loud voice sounded from the private room on the second floor.
"2200 gold coins," shouted a bearded man in the lobby on the first floor.
"For 2,500 gold coins, I can be Liu Yunfei of the Liu family." A voice came from the private room on the second floor.
I don’t know whether the uncle on the first floor was threatened from behind or because he lacked financial resources. He didn’t continue to increase the price. The first lot was taken by Liu Yunfei.
At the auction, items were sold one after another amidst the fierce competition among everyone.
"The next auction item is a yellow-level alchemy furnace, Cangyun Cauldron, with a starting price of 3,000 gold coins," Yu Yuanyang announced in a sweet voice.
There was no sound in the hall on the first floor, and there was a pause.
At this time, Liu Yunfei reported, "3500 gold coins. If no one wants it, this tripod will belong to me."
"5000 gold coins" Ye Chen quoted the price without delay.
"5100" Liu Yunfei shouted urgently
"6000" Ye Chen is bound to win
"6100" Liu Yunfei was a little angry,
"7000" Ye Chen is not to be outdone
"7100 gold coins. Boy, I am from the Liu family, and my brother Liu Yunlong is an inner disciple of the Wentian Sect."
"8000, is the Liu family amazing?" Because of Liu Yanran's relationship, Ye Chen was not too embarrassed.
"Hmph, 8,500 gold coins" Liu Yunfei shouted angrily
"Gold coins" Ye Chen replied calmly.
Liu Yunfei is no longer raising the price. The yellow-level alchemy furnace will basically not exceed 10,000 gold coins. If it doesn't work, he will buy it next time. He told his subordinates, "Liu Kui, keep an eye on this kid when it's over."
The maid sent Cangyun Ding to the private room, and Ye Chen made the dealTen thousand gold coins, and now there are more than 90,000 gold coins left.
Jade Yuanyang's sweet voice sounded again, "The auction below is a Xuan-level Dingfeng Thunder Sword, with a starting price of 20,000 gold coins."
"30,000 gold coins," a grizzled old man on the first floor shouted, full of energy. The monk who built the ninth heaven is probably from other places. The sword of the Xuan-level Dingfeng is extremely rare in Qianfeng Kingdom. Of course, the sect is still more optimistic.
"Gold Coin" Liu Yunfei
"40,000"
